thread:
maria: FYI seeing 10-15% latency tail bump for small-gen requests in ledger-eu dedicated pool since yesterday evening. egress credit usage also spiked; seems related to our new preempt handshake + affinity changes.
ash: hmm, any noisy neighbor signals? p99 CPU/NET on nodes? logs?
jia: I pulled prometheus: 
```
sum(rate(egress_bytes_total{pool="ledger-eu"}[5m])) by (instance)
```
...shows two hosts at ~3x baseline.
devon: that's the preempt handshake we pushed last week — when a preempt happens we route off-host and then try to reacquire. If the reconnection window is long it causes egress blips and hot-path re-routes.
sre-bot: ALERT ledger-eu: egress_bandwidth > 80% for 2 hosts (02:13:07 UTC)
maria: thanks. can we temporarily shorten handshake timeout and prefer local fallback rather than cross-az fallback? cost-wise cross-az egress is killing us.
ash: +1. propose: set preempt-handshake=30s, fallback-policy=local-first. also add a soft cap for egress per-node to avoid tail thrash.
devon: quick CLI to try on canary: 
```
redwoodctl routing update --pool ledger-eu --set preempt_timeout=30s --set fallback=local-first
redwoodctl quota update --node node-12 --egress-softcap=200MB/s
```
jia: will run query to pick canary nodes and watch. I'll also add an alert for cross-az egress spikes.
maria: action: devon apply canary change to ledger-eu for 2 nodes (node-12,node-18). jia: observe for 30m and report. if stable, roll to slice.
nash: FYI estimated cost delta if cross-az fallback continues: ~$2.3k/day for the shard. putting on infra-costs.
maria: tagging @finance for visibility. :warning: keep engineering alerted. thanks team.
nash: I'll open a brief runbook snippet in docs/ops for the handshake tuning after we verify.
devon: rolled to canary at 1745600039. watch logs: "preempt handshake succeeded" / "fallback local" messages should appear.
jia: 10m in — egress per-host normalized, tail latency reduced p99 from 820ms -> 210ms. good signal.
maria: moving to roll at 1745600067 unless objections. :thumbsup:
nash: +1
